name: پیشنهاد سریال
description: A Persian viewer asks for series suggestions in three phrasings. Verifies the movies_tv_series fact answers in Persian with a mixed list (Breaking Bad, Succession, Severance, Dark, Ted Lasso, Squid Game).

turns.text: چه سریالی ببینم این آخر هفته؟

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: "چه سریالی ببینم" returns the series list. Turn 2: the imperative request returns the same list. Turn 3: the bare "سریال چی ببینم" matches the dedicated series keywords.
expected.behavior: Series-specific Persian keywords (چه سریالی ببینم, سریال پیشنهاد بده, سریال چی ببینم) outscore the generic movie fact for series requests, so the dedicated list answers.
